item.title: Shrinkwrap 0.23.0
item.description: New @face tag: square avatars around every face Vision finds — 600px, editable zoom, up to 5 per photo, sources with nobody in them get tagged no-face-found. The same folder can now be watched safely on any number of Macs: each machine keeps its own log, and whichever claims a drop first does the work. The menu is a live status board — what's processing now and what needs attention, by folder name, nothing else. Plus the last of the review fixes.
